requirements.assessment: The retained P04 profile handles finite choices and bounded integers with rational-linear cells. It tests original strict feasibility before closure bounds, checks endpoint attainment separately, preserves explored-only partial extrema and keeps unsupported/unknown distinct from infeasible. Debt amounts avoid the rounded-total fraction product; transformation of a ratio requires a proved denominator sign. Declared half-even display domains and posting quantisation are separate. Nonlinear solving, unbounded integer search and general symbolic rounding remain outside this evidence.

P17 must identify which actual corporate, instrument and sector operations leave that fragment and either give a sound admitted reformulation or return an explicit unsupported result. Specify conflict labels and partial-family aggregation so a local bound is never advertised as a global optimum; preserve source rounding as unresolved when unknown. No default nonlinear fallback or performance claim is justified.
requirements.design_consequence: Solver capability is checked on the actual formula and query scope. An unsupported economic operation is a design limitation, not evidence that the company history is impossible.

requirements.assessment: P07 specifies append-only Proposed/Accepted/AcceptedAlternative/Rejected/Superseded decisions with reviewer, rationale, applicability and reconciliation. Its tests cover a rejected extraction, accepted repair, subsequent correction, incompatible alternatives, old-view preservation and invalidation of late-created descendants. This is stronger than a state-name sketch, but supplies a bounded local store and synthetic conflict exercise rather than an adjudicated analyst workflow.

Supply a complete conflict case showing evidence, rationale, alternative preservation, dependency ownership, permitted reuse and current versus historical result access. Specify stale requests, unknown availability and supersession eligibility together with MC05/MC25. P17/P18 must supply real-case proposed answers and independently review the treatment where needed; an interface demonstration is not human acceptance.
requirements.design_consequence: Corrections create new evidence views and dependent results. Review permissions and dependencies must remain explicit whichever persistence engine or frontend is proposed.

Supply expected results and independent annotations/adjudication appropriate to each layer, including chronology, source conflict and alternative-preservation cases. Retain Northstar as a transparent synthetic example; do not treat the Apple stress or the source panel as full-company closure.
requirements.design_consequence: A complete teaching case, a real disclosure fragment and a source-acquired panel serve different purposes. The initial profile must still explain its relation to whole-company representation.

requirements.assessment: The retained survey now has individual title/metadata decisions for all 179 unique forward-query candidates, separate source-support and claim ledgers, selected backward links and source-specific omissions. The blanket exclusions identified by the old G8 audit are no longer the current screening method. That repair is not full technical review of the candidates. For example, richer provenance is explicitly deferred, and library-versus-DSL support is limited to a surveyed design tradeoff in the archived December 2003 CWI report SEN-E0309 corresponding to Mernik et al. (2005), rather than AccDSL superiority or unchecked publication-version equivalence. Later accounting/actuarial/forecast methods remain unevenly supported.
requirements.remaining_work: P17 must map each proposed method to inspected primary technical sections, equations, assumptions, relevant appendices and original code when available; inspect direct competitors, corrections and negative findings before selection. Expand provenance beyond positive queries only with matching semantics; compare reconstruction/identification and uncertainty approaches, standards-specific corporate/group/instrument methods, bank allowances and insurer measurement/reserving, and forecasting baselines. Resolve important deferred leads or justify omission for the selected scope, record version/retraction/erratum checks, and keep title/metadata screens and source-blocked works outside technical support. Citation counts cannot choose methods.
requirements.design_consequence: The survey supports specific bounded claims. Architecture and method breadth require claim-by-claim research, not a ledger-count threshold or automatic adoption of cited tools.

requirements.assessment: The catalogue identifies 36 papers, with 32 local PDF paths and four source-blocked entries (McCarthy 1982, Caiani et al. 2016, Imielinski/Lipski 1984 and Tamer 2010). This audit rehashed all 32 listed PDFs against the catalogue with no mismatch. Support records distinguish targeted technical reading, versions and forbidden stronger claims. Financial-report originals and selected authority copies are retained separately; paper integrity does not certify the scientific support of every sentence or the current authority of a standards version.
requirements.remaining_work: P17 must retain legitimate primary copies for newly decision-relevant methods with exact edition/version, local hash and technical anchors; inspect methods/theory/relevant appendices and official implementations before relying on them. The four blocked papers remain unavailable for technical claims unless a legitimate primary copy is obtained; do not substitute unchecked summaries. Record corrections/retractions and reconcile working-paper versus publication differences. Preserve the original collection and release-pinned filing bytes; add source-backed versions without overwriting historical evidence.
requirements.design_consequence: Copy availability, integrity, technical inspection and authority applicability remain separate source properties. A blocked foundational paper limits its claim, not independent feasible research.

requirements.assessment: The tool survey retains official descriptions, licences and selected interface snapshots; the Arelle snapshot exposes fact contexts and units. P11 provides adapter input/output conventions, discovery records and six matched frontend tasks, but external_integrations_completed is zero: Arelle, QuantLib and Docling modules were absent from the recorded interpreter, the ACTUS executable was absent from the captured PATH, and no local ledger engine was selected. Inline scaling, physical PDF locations, the ACTUS service translator and Ledger/hledger wire translators are not demonstrated. Z3 has separate bounded P04 execution evidence. Availability in P11 is historical environment evidence, not a global capability verdict.
requirements.remaining_work: P17 must choose reuse only after defining and checking each boundary: XBRL nil/duplicates/scale/context/taxonomy extensions; PDF text/table/page coordinates and model licences; ACTUS economic events versus accounting treatment; QuantLib valuation date, conventions and calibration inputs; ledger signs, currency, rounding and posting identity. Specify pinned releases/commits, code/model/dependency licences, deterministic errors, malformed/reordered/duplicate replies and absence behavior. Existing snapshots and synthetic replies do not count as end-to-end external execution; integration and deployment evidence remain future authorised work. No package or service is installed in this audit.
requirements.design_consequence: Reuse choices are replaceable adapters with explicit semantic boundaries. A missing backend can preserve an unavailable result but cannot be replaced by fabricated successful integration.

requirements.assessment: The existing Version 1.2 manuscript stages the synthetic company, real disclosure boundaries, methods, contracts and separate acceptance questions. The retained author review records a 79-page build/render and baseline-preservation pass, with human comprehension pending. This audit inspected current PDF text at pages 12/61/67 and rendered pages 12/67; the synthetic/real-case distinction and provisional workload qualification are legible there. This targeted inspection does not renew a whole-manuscript visual or human-voice acceptance, and P15–P17 decisions remain to be integrated.
requirements.remaining_work: P18 must incorporate the reviewed P16 architecture and P17 methods into one coherent LaTeX/PDF argument with reader prerequisites, definitions, explicit derivations, source anchors, complete cases and implementation/failure contracts. Reconcile broad contracts against admitted profile behavior and retire obsolete architecture decisions while preserving equations, citations, assumptions and qualifications against the protected baseline. Record a fresh stable-input build and inspect the actual rendered candidate throughout; obtain independent implementability and human comprehension feedback separately. A clean build cannot close these requirements.
requirements.design_consequence: The existing PDF is substantive design evidence and a protected comparison baseline; only a newly integrated, reviewed manuscript can govern the eventual implementation.

evidence.locator: PDF pages 61 and 67 (printed pages 56 and 62), sections 11.1 and 11.9

requirements.assessment: The manuscript separates engineering, accounting and forecast evidence and specifies matched authoring and later forecast baselines. P12 reports 12/12 deterministic chronology cases and 15/15 repetitions across five synthetic workload cells; four source references remain provisional and no extraction task is scored. Its purposive issuer-family exposure record denies a clean heldout claim, groups dependent years/versions together and records unknown evaluated-model training exposure. The 10,000-observation/100-slot/64-cell/30-second manuscript limits are provisional choices, not measured production capacity.
requirements.remaining_work: P16–P19 must define canonical selected-profile inputs/outputs and semantic rejection/partial-result criteria, with independent expectations and explicit source, accounting, forecast and human acceptance layers. P17 must finish annotation/adjudication, issuer-family/version/time splits and exposure/duplicate handling before empirical use. Declare operational workloads, resource stops and failure reporting; evaluate actual capacity later. Forecast comparison needs matched information cutoffs and scenario conditioning, naive and tuned conventional baselines, single-interpretation and alternative-preserving variants, uncertainty and critical-regime vetoes. No ranking, forecast calibration or default-readiness follows from deterministic examples or descriptive timings.
requirements.design_consequence: Acceptance is claim-specific: source integrity, semantic conformance, accounting authority, empirical prediction and reader acceptance require different evidence and cannot substitute for one another.

requirements.assessment: The saved register preserves all fifteen historical phases with honest scope: P08 is incomplete, P09/P10/P13/P14 are unexecuted, and accepted prototypes remain exploratory/source evidence. The bounded MC25/G18 and MC34 provenance/reporting repair received AGREE; that review did not accept MC07/G12 or full P15. Current coverage retains all MC01–MC35/G1–G18. The earlier manuscript implementation order and IR-first wording remain proposals to reconcile, not authority to resume product implementation. The P15 Initial-profile comparison now separates domain scope from authoring and compares four candidates on matched obligations without selecting one.
requirements.remaining_work: Obtain full independent P15 result review of the integrated audit and matched profile comparison, explicitly including MC07/G12. P16 must select and justify a proposed initial profile, assign whole-product obligations to explicit later profiles and define dependencies, interactions, stops and open decisions. P17–P19 must carry exact requirement/case/source traceability through methods, manuscript and readiness without changing the original acceptance requirements. Preserve frozen phase evidence and separately report specification, prototype checks, accounting/forecast evidence and human status after material changes. The accepted bounded provenance repair remains accepted within its recorded scope.
requirements.design_consequence: Staging may defer execution but cannot erase mission requirements or promote historical success into architecture approval. Review and source versions must be explicit.

requirements.assessment: The internal-before-expert allocation gives all G1–G18 feasible internal tasks and only conditional later professional judgments. Source acquisition, selected dossiers/calculations and P12 preparation are retained internal work; P12 still reports provisional source references and no professional adjudication. The author review explicitly says no packet is ready for a paid actual-company opinion. Human acceptance and professional engagement remain separate from continued internal preparation.
requirements.remaining_work: P17 must finish actual-company facts, dated authority and applicability, competing interpretations, calculations and software/source diagnostics for each proposed question; keep missing definitions, annotations, case closure and adapter work on the internal queue. Refer only a residual judgment that internal evidence cannot settle, with a proposed answer, exact paragraphs, counterargument and checked consequences. P18 can continue provisional drafting pending ordinary reader feedback. No outreach, fees, professional-readiness claim or savings estimate is authorised; any engagement requires separate user authority after a concrete bounded brief.
requirements.design_consequence: Pending external judgment does not stop feasible internal proposal work. Accounting opinion, empirical causal/forecast validation and ordinary reader comprehension are distinct needs.

gaps.assessment: The later manuscript and P04 now give finite construction semantics, declared template/slot instantiation and coverage counts, improving the initial gap baseline. Actual P04 remains supplied-scope reconstruction: no arbitrary template discovery or full filing-to-history procedure is established.
gaps.remaining_work: P16 must bind ModelScope, cell coverage, unmatched observations and unsupported operations to the history-family contract. P17 must specify reviewed-disclosure-to-candidate rules and bounded slot choices, with shared account/note/date constraints, included/rejected/excluded histories and a source-obligation coverage example. Testable proposal fixtures must distinguish no witness yet, one witness and complete declared search; broader real-world completeness stays unsupported.
gaps.design_consequence: A complete solver response is meaningful only relative to the exposed template registry and evidence obligations; hidden scope exclusions could otherwise remove a future-sensitive history.

gaps.assessment: The manuscript now distinguishes engineering, accounting, forecast and human acceptance; its workload numbers are expressly provisional. P12 is a finite synthetic conformance result with recorded denominators, truthful partial/unsupported cases and descriptive timing, not an extraction benchmark or release validation. Structural P15 checks and internally accepted historical phases cannot establish full proposal acceptance.
gaps.remaining_work: P16–P19 must bind each selected-profile claim to concrete expected outputs, rejection/partial-result semantics, source/authority limits and review ownership. Specify annotation/adjudication and issuer-family/version exposure rules; declare realistic workloads and measured resource evidence before capacity claims. Preserve a matched forecast baseline ladder with information cutoffs, statistical uncertainty and vetoes before predictive ranking. Integrate every MC/G obligation and material decision, complete independent proposal review and retain human acceptance pending until actual feedback. Counts, builds and schema checks remain limited evidence.
gaps.design_consequence: Completion requires the evidence appropriate to the claimed behavior; an internally consistent example or passing structural report cannot stand in for method or human acceptance.

gaps.assessment: The old claim that no coverage/translation procedure exists is stale. The repaired chapter defines separate denominators, traversal and stop conditions, while Narrative and CoverageUnit give record shapes. The gap persists in demonstrated whole-package inventory and reviewed meaning: P02 reports zero fully formalised notes and 23 notes with unresolved meaning. P15 audit boundary: retained as partial documentary evidence, not a closure claim.
gaps.remaining_work: Retain full MC01/MC03 scope: reconciled package, typed narrative examples, cross-reference closure or precise outstanding obligations, and disclosure-to-constraint links carrying qualifications. Specify review of headings and table continuations before asserting a complete semantic denominator.
gaps.design_consequence: Credit the procedure repair without closing whole-report coverage. Files, pages, notes and checked bridges measure different populations and cannot certify complete financial meaning.

gaps.assessment: G12 is partly addressed: Mapping/Partition record shapes exist; the manuscript specifies contextual relations, two composition constraints, residual preservation and two classifications of 260 that cannot be summed to 520. P06 enumerates disjoint/exhaustive finite populations, accepts a known residual membership witness, rejects unknown residuals and shared-population addition, and checks exact component arithmetic. The older claim that partitions and residual handling are wholly unspecified and unexecuted is wrong relative to this evidence. General registry resolution, company extensions over time, source-proven comparability and measurement transformations remain incomplete.
gaps.remaining_work: Define registry identity/version and executable applicability, relation-specific composition, ambiguity/cycle handling and invalidation. Distinguish finite membership completeness from completeness of a real disclosure population, and known residual membership from known residual amounts. Provide complete source-backed same-quantity/different-label and different-measurement/similar-label records; extend the Apple distinction into an application case. Specify cross-context/gross-net refusal or justified transformations, dated extension/perimeter-change cases, and product/geography totals over a canonical shared population with unresolved joint cells preserved.
gaps.design_consequence: Comparability must be demonstrated or left unresolved without imposing a universal chart of accounts. A direct mapping, known=True residual flag or disjoint-ID union is insufficient to authorize financial addition or conversion. P06 rejection behavior informs failure semantics but does not supply the missing accounting method.

gaps.assessment: The older blanket absence of historical query rules has been repaired: the manuscript now provides eligibility filtering, selective acyclic supersession, maximal conflicts and named views, with exact publication/ingestion fixtures. The bounded P06 implementation is useful exploratory evidence. Wider MC19 dated accounting-treatment transitions and MC25 complete version/API semantics are not closed by temporal arithmetic or the small fixture. P15 audit boundary: retained as partial documentary evidence, not a closure claim.
gaps.remaining_work: Resolve missing-ingestion/byte-vintage policy and provide fixtures for eligible conflicting corrections, unrelated unchanged notes, unknown publication times and invalid cross-calendar/basis/perimeter subtraction. Specify prospective estimate and retrospective error/policy transitions with applicable authority, explicit effective dates and opening bridges; those authority decisions remain for MC19/P17.
gaps.design_consequence: Preserve clocks and treatment-version selection as separate contracts. The same economic date can support different legitimate views, but a harmonised transformation never overwrites its source. No general standards-transition validity follows from the Northstar arithmetic.

gaps.assessment: The manuscript and core contract now define three scenario meanings. P05 exercises exogenous paths and illustrative finite conditioning; P06 explicitly limits its information guard to exogenous stress, checks announced/future-realised visibility and rejects other operations. Cross-interface capability and arbitrary-plugin access remain proposal obligations.
gaps.remaining_work: P16 must reconcile mode names/support, specify dated information capabilities and visibility, and separate inner valuation randomness from outer outcomes. P17 must supply a manager and an allowance/measurement example using admissible forecasts while rejecting future realised defaults; demonstrate that stress leaves historical weights unchanged and genuine evidence changes them only under a justified law. Intervention must name supported structural equations or return unsupported.
gaps.design_consequence: Advertise support at the operation boundary. A typed scenario record is insufficient if its execution or information policy is unavailable; conditional, stressed and intervened outcomes must remain distinguishable.

gaps.assessment: The normative six-kind rules and P06 semantic rejection cases repair the original generic-category gap within a bounded registry. Package permissions, finite fact domains, estimates and information dates are checked as supplied; their authority, substantive admissibility and broader dependencies remain open.
gaps.remaining_work: P16 must specify kind-dependent update/invalidation and source-versus-treatment separation. P17 must supply source-backed election eligibility and estimate applicability, linked fact/reading alternatives and an unsupported treatment that remains preserved as an assertion. Add proposal examples for accepted, evidence-refuted and prohibited alternatives and for dependent revisions; a field-complete registry is insufficient authority.
gaps.design_consequence: The evidence store can preserve an erroneous claim without admitting its treatment to the feasible accounting family. Distinct kinds need distinct update and rejection semantics.

gaps.assessment: The manuscript states resolution records and an additive proof condition. Retained P06 cases preserve fixed-bullet principal/interest and invalidate stale queries; a narrow fixed-rate approximation has an analytic error certificate. General cohort/lot transformations and empirical sector error remain unsupported.
gaps.remaining_work: P16/P17 must define memory keys and allowed transformations by output/scenario/horizon/rule version, detail-preserving refinement and invalidation. Give exact safe and unsafe groupings, including a lost maturity/reset/guarantee exposure; specify approximation error units, tolerances, justification and reassessment rules. Do not generalise the fixed-rate triangle bound to nonlinear guarantees, netting, impairment or insurance without new method evidence.
gaps.design_consequence: A grouping is valid only for its declared future questions. Retaining totals alone can destroy economically material histories even when current statements reconcile.

gaps.assessment: The manuscript and P07 now specify Proposed, Accepted, AcceptedAlternative, Rejected and Superseded transitions, required rationale/context/reconciliation, append-only decisions, conflicts, old-view preservation and transitive invalidation. Historical P07 evidence includes late-descendant and unrelated-source cases. The old omission finding is therefore substantially repaired. Complete MC27 analyst workflow, real conflict adjudication and layer-aware general dependency semantics remain open. P15 audit boundary: retained as partial documentary evidence, not a closure claim.
gaps.remaining_work: Integrate the local transition table and explicit accepted-layer contract into the whole-product proposal. Supply a source-backed conflict/alternative walkthrough from raw reading to changed conclusions, including invalid transitions, descendants and unaffected results. Preserve MC27 human workflow and acceptance separately; no multi-user hierarchy is required.
gaps.design_consequence: Review approval, extraction confidence, accounting validity and history probabilities remain different quantities. A new view must not reuse a stale result or silently attach old journals to new evidence; prior views remain reproducible.

gaps.assessment: P07 demonstrates bounded NFC/ASCII/reduced-rational canonicalization, event/branch/stream identity checks, duplicate/conflict handling, schema-1-to-2 equal-value migration and exact P05 replay across reopening. Branch enumeration and reversal of a dependency-ordered P05 schedule are checked; arbitrary independent-event commutation and stochastic outcome invariance are not. Correction tests preserve historical views and invalidate current descendants. Cross-language canonicalization, broader migration semantics, cross-adapter replay and an independent implementation remain unestablished. The hash-derived stream tuple is an identity primitive; production stochastic execution is Unsupported.
gaps.remaining_work: Specify byte-level canonical vectors and exactly equal versus tolerance-based comparisons for formatting-only edits, evidence corrections, independent-event reordering, duplicate IDs and branch order. Distinguish demonstrated P05 identity/order checks from general commutation and stochastic outcome invariance. Extend migration semantics beyond schema 1→2; specify generator/transform versions and coupling/consumption across branches.
gaps.design_consequence: The proposal must separate invariance of representation from changes in evidence/model/run meaning, with exact equality rules or justified numerical tolerances for each case. Preserve P07 examples as bounded conformance candidates without promoting them to cross-implementation or stochastic guarantees.

gaps.assessment: The original record/grammar omission has been partly repaired by Core 0 revision 2, its closed IR definitions and demonstration package; the complete built-in table is present. P03 implements a narrower authoring subset and P07 separately exercises review/recovery semantics. Their existence does not prove a unified compiler/runtime supports the broad contract.
gaps.remaining_work: P16 must publish one consistent selected-profile contract linking syntax, binding, IR records, contextual typing, package version/capability admission, pure built-ins, event/report interfaces, numeric encoding and every result/error variant. Provide positive and semantic-negative source-to-result examples, including a corrected disclosure, an alternative history and a rejected override. Reconcile the separate P03/P04/P07 restrictions and the G12/G15/G17/G18 interactions; list later capabilities without claiming them implemented. This replaces the obsolete claim that all record and built-in definitions are absent.
gaps.design_consequence: Independent implementations must agree on admitted behavior and explicit failures; merely validating the same schema or reusing one compiler cannot establish that agreement.

gaps.assessment: The rounded-debt amount parameterisation and strict-bound semantics are now derived in the manuscript and exercised in P04. The example attains 4.975 but only approaches 7.035. Exact linear, finite and bounded-integer capabilities remain distinct from unsupported nonlinear or unbounded-integer models.
gaps.remaining_work: P16/P17 must enumerate formula and query capabilities; require denominator sign/nonzero and fixed-threshold proofs for ratio rewrites; specify observation rounding versus posting quantisation; retain unknown/unsupported/timeout/infeasible/unbounded as distinct outcomes. Provide nonlinear/fraction-sign and partial-search proposal cases whose formulas and uncertified bounds survive, plus an explicit approximation/error policy before any nonlinear extension.
gaps.design_consequence: Use an equivalent amount model only under its stated domain. Neither a continuous relaxation nor a sampled range may replace the requested exact family or certify attainable extrema.

gaps.assessment: The original inventory-of-duties finding has been partly repaired: the manuscript supplies Northstar operation templates and a full annual/interim/revision/forecast example, plus separate assumed-control acquisition, elimination and disposal arithmetic. The local oracle checks prewritten postings; the consolidation check evaluates totals, not the full dated elimination procedure. FX remains a required conformance case without an equivalent complete currency example in these inspected sources. The package is illustrative rather than a dated corporate accounting regime.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must connect supported corporate treatments to dated authority, operation preconditions and journals, then to a complete statement/note set. Extend the connected case through correction and a perimeter or currency transition with acquisition versus operating cash, NCI, policy alignment and separate elimination/translation adjustments. Include unmatched intragroup balances, unknown control/purchase allocation, noncash additions and FX-rate/functional-currency ambiguity as explicit failures or unresolved alternatives. Define specific later methods for returns/variable consideration, leases, impairment and current/deferred tax rather than generic broader-accounting residuals.
gaps.design_consequence: Northstar repairs the missing connected illustration but cannot close corporate-method scope. Preserve MC06 control uncertainty, G5 source-to-statement lineage, G12 measurement/perimeter compatibility and G16 state resolution when adding accounting operations.

gaps.assessment: The repaired manuscript supplies a complete synthetic company example and a real Apple inventory/marginal-stress example, with explicit partial semantic coverage. P12 adds bounded chronology/workload checks but zero scored source-extraction tasks. Neither acquisition of the panel nor synthetic expected journals supplies the missing report-wide real-company path.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must prepare an internally reconciled real annual/interim package covering material statements, notes, policies and incorporation obligations. Carry source contexts, review states, unknowns and shared alternative histories into economic events, dated treatments, journals and future statements/notes with traceable expected results. Include a corrected disclosure and demonstrate preservation of materially distinct exposures; provide independent layer-appropriate annotations rather than copying one generator output. P18 must teach that full path while distinguishing unresolved real facts from synthetic illustrations.
gaps.design_consequence: Whole-report inventory completeness and whole-company semantic/forecast coverage have different completion criteria; the proposal must make both explicit.

gaps.assessment: The original interface-only baseline now has P05 conditional Northstar economic-event execution and P04 finite probability mechanics, with explicit failure-mass examples. Neither establishes calibrated economic behaviour, actual Apple exposure or a general probabilistic forecasting method. P05 endpoint paths are not complete continuous-family evaluation.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must specify one transparent operating baseline linking drivers to sales/costs/collections/inventory/capex/financing, its timing/information/funding rules and parameter provenance. Supply a justified optional historical-and-future joint law, evidence update and partially executable vector-output example, alongside unweighted results. P16 must define common result/mass semantics; empirical target-specific calibration and forecast validation stay separately planned and cannot be inferred from deterministic journal bridges.
gaps.design_consequence: A coherent conditional accounting path can be useful before forecast calibration, but its assumed behaviour and probabilities must remain visible. Unsupported branches and default cannot be dropped to make summaries look complete.

gaps.assessment: Standards/sector specification has advanced beyond the original deferral: inventory and compound-bond examples, a bank funding/capital path and a separate-gross/ceded PAA roll-forward now exist. Their evidence is heterogeneous: exact arithmetic and bounded source paragraphs, one admitted Australian P08 lifecycle, unresolved other-basis treatments, and no executed P09/P10 work. Neither bookkeeping balance nor the later P08 engineering pass establishes accounting applicability, bank allowance/prudential methods or general insurance measurement.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must complete the dated operation/authority/election/transition matrix and genuine matched-treatment examples (MC19); instrument eligibility and full admitted lifecycle (MC17); bank credit/allowance, funding/default and prudential reconciliation (MC21); and insurance grouping/PAA eligibility, recognition, general measurement, RA/CSM, reinsurance, transition and asset interactions (MC22). P16 must preserve extension admission and sector-required state (MC20), including negative override cases. Retain each source-limited or later operation explicitly with inputs, failure behavior and required case, while completing feasible internal authority and contract preparation before expert referral. Unexecuted P09/P10 are future obligations, not evidence of completion.
gaps.design_consequence: Sector cases constrain common state, chronology, authority selection, mappings and uncertainty before architecture selection. A narrower initial profile may stage these methods but cannot drop G7 or silently reuse one standard's treatment in another book.

gaps.assessment: The old blanket-exclusion defect has a substantive repair: 179 individual metadata decisions and separate technical-support records. Important direct-method, competitor and extension leads are still deferred; 32 archived catalogue papers and six ledger types do not establish whole-mission research depth. Four catalogue papers remain source-blocked.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must supply a domain/method-to-claim research map and resolve the relevant deferred competitors, not merely expand counts. Prioritise hidden-history reconstruction, exact/approximate aggregation, likelihood and identification assumptions, dated accounting/sector methods and forecast evaluation. For each adopted result inspect the technical argument, applicable appendices and official code; record equations, assumptions, versions, correction checks and admissible local deductions. Keep unsupported authority and inaccessible foundational sources as explicit claim limits and continue independent source work.
gaps.design_consequence: Research completion is defined by support for the selected proposal and justified omissions; metadata relevance decisions cannot certify a mathematical method.

gaps.assessment: Official software snapshots and specified adapter conventions now exist, so a claim that no exchange contracts exist would be stale. P11 nevertheless records zero completed external integrations, discovery-only unavailable backends and unexercised translations. Shared-frontend agreement is separate from external adapter execution.
gaps.remaining_work: P17 must reconcile proposed exchanges with actual official interfaces and pinned versions/licences for each selected dependency, state lossless fields and semantic transformations, and define error/absence behavior and independent expected results. Provide source-backed designs for XBRL context/nil/scale/duplicates, PDF coordinates, contract-event calendars, valuation inputs and ledger signs/currencies/idempotency. Specify later real-engine positive and adversarial fixtures; ACTUS service and ledger wire translation, inline scale and physical PDF provenance remain explicit unsupported boundaries until demonstrated. Keep authoring comparison separate under MC23.
gaps.design_consequence: An adapter specification can govern later implementation without pretending that a discovery or stub exercise is a completed integration.

open_decisions.question: When may a filing package be called complete?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Declare separate acquired-unit, reviewed-assertion and query-exposure populations and retain material unresolved incorporated targets.
open_decisions.alternative: A single completeness score or closure only over acquired files.
open_decisions.consequence: An aggregate score could conceal absent contracts and overstate downstream support.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a reconciled annual/interim package with duplicate, unavailable, ambiguous and resource-limited references and query consequences.

open_decisions.question: How does a narrative reading become a constraint?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Bind scope, time, modality, exceptions and contexts explicitly; accept translation separately and label added thresholds as assumptions.
open_decisions.alternative: Free-text scope with generic acceptance and implementation-defined translation.
open_decisions.consequence: Implementations could turn permissions into payments or fixed coupons into fixed aggregate exposure.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify positive and rejected translations and unresolved-predicate effects in the evidence/language contracts.

open_decisions.question: May source preparation infer a half-unit interval from displayed precision when the rounding rule is unknown?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Separate display precision from the issuer rounding convention; retain unknowns and permit a named conditional nearest-rounding compatibility model with explicit assumption provenance.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat the displayed unit as sufficient evidence for a half-unit interval, or reject all conditional rounding analysis.
open_decisions.consequence: The first overstates source support; the second prevents useful conditional analysis. Existing P02 and the general contract are not yet aligned on this distinction.
open_decisions.next_step: Inspect the unit and rounding disclosures, distinguish unknown nearest convention from unknown tie rule, and specify assumption-labelled examples with missing and known rounding metadata.

open_decisions.question: Which missing time/version fields may a query tolerate?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Keep exploratory archival results explicitly qualified; reject or return unresolved for system-as-of claims without ingestion evidence and for investor-information evaluation without justified availability and byte vintage.
open_decisions.alternative: Carry P06 defaults forward: infer ingestion from availability and select unknown-vintage bytes by default.
open_decisions.consequence: The alternative can produce results labelled as historical knowledge that the retained evidence does not establish.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify distinct query admission modes and fixtures for absent versus explicit-null ingestion, unknown publication and unverified bytes, then reconcile P06 with the proposal.

open_decisions.question: What does review acceptance authorise across extraction and interpretation layers?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Name the accepted layer, preserve alternatives/conflicts, and propagate status and transitive invalidation through explicit dependencies.
open_decisions.alternative: One undifferentiated accepted status usable as an accounting constraint.
open_decisions.consequence: A faithful extraction of a disputed or incorrect assertion could otherwise become an endorsed treatment.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify a real source-backed conflict walkthrough and cross-layer transition/admission examples under MC04/MC27 before general workflow acceptance.

open_decisions.question: Which initial profile should be proposed for implementation?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Make separate domain-scope and authoring-interface decisions using the saved four-profile comparison. Evaluate corporate/shared-IR and typed-library-first on identical corporate semantics; consider instrument-first only with an explicit whole-company continuation, and broad sector-first only with its admitted sector/authority dependencies specified. Keep selection for P16 review.
open_decisions.alternative: Choose Core 0/Northstar or the instrument prototype because it exists; treat typed-library-first as a smaller accounting domain; or label sectors supported before their methods are specified.
open_decisions.consequence: Conflating interface and domain scope creates an unfair comparison and can conceal dropped whole-company obligations. All candidates must preserve evidence, joint histories, time, treatment, failure, review/recovery and extension semantics.
open_decisions.next_step: P16 must use the audit comparison to specify included/excluded operations, interface options, dependency order and common positive/negative fixtures; record the rationale and remaining obligations without unsupported cost or usability rankings.

open_decisions.question: What authority is sufficient for cross-standard and sector treatment claims?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Admit only dated, locally archived primary passages and company facts within their scope; keep US GAAP/ASBE, bank prudential and broad insurance operations partial until inspected.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat overview material, company policy or illustrative arithmetic as general authority.
open_decisions.consequence: Unbounded authority would turn structural examples into unsupported accounting claims.
open_decisions.next_step: Build P17 method dossiers with rule versions, matched cases, source limits and unresolved operations.

open_decisions.question: What evidence is sufficient for an end-to-end proposal readiness claim?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Require P15 coverage, P16 contracts, P17 methods, P18 rendered manuscript/build review and P19 independent review, with engineering, accounting, forecast and human states separate.
open_decisions.alternative: Treat passing structural checks, a compiled PDF or prototype phase acceptances as readiness.
open_decisions.consequence: Proxy evidence could incorrectly enable implementation or imply accounting validity.
open_decisions.next_step: Carry the separation into every later artifact and readiness decision.

open_decisions.question: How should unresolved branches and partial execution appear in outputs?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Return explicit feasible/unknown/infeasible/unsupported/default/internal-failure statuses with branch lineage and retained unresolved mass; never silently drop or renormalize.
open_decisions.alternative: Return successful branches only or collapse unresolved branches into a default.
open_decisions.consequence: Downstream statements and forecasts would overstate certainty and lose dependence.
open_decisions.next_step: Specify result payloads and failure fixtures in P16/P17 before implementation.

open_decisions.question: Which representation defines portable semantics, and which authoring interfaces are initially required?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Specify inspectable serialisable financial meaning and compare typed constructors with textual notation on identical domain tasks; retain common context and admission checks. Exact IR, language and frontend choices remain proposals.
open_decisions.alternative: Make host-language state or a text parser the sole semantic authority, or infer correctness from shared-compiler agreement.
open_decisions.consequence: Portability, source provenance, corrections and migration require meaning independent of one caller; deferring a parser does not remove DSL design or accounting obligations.
open_decisions.next_step: P16: specify normative records/semantics and independent expected outputs, diagnostics/source locations and migration examples for matched authoring tasks.

open_decisions.question: Which numerical operations and incomplete outcomes can the initial profile honestly admit?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Declare capability by formula/query after expansion, with exact/approximate status, rounding boundaries and typed partial/unsupported replies; retain linear/finite methods as candidate fragments.
open_decisions.alternative: Force all accounting methods into a linear solver, or promise general nonlinear inference without specified methods.
open_decisions.consequence: Unsupported sector formulas and resource limits must remain visible rather than producing misleading exact bounds or silent branch loss.
open_decisions.next_step: P16/P17: map admitted operation formulas to capabilities and supply strict-endpoint, rounding, unsupported and budget-exhaustion examples before choosing a solver.

open_decisions.question: What entity and economic memory must survive aggregation and extension?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Retain legal entity, evidence-backed control, perimeter versions and query-relevant contract/lot/cohort state with explicit refinement and invalidation.
open_decisions.alternative: Store aggregate account totals and assume omitted rights, timing and dependencies can be recovered later.
open_decisions.consequence: Histories with identical totals may have different scenario responses; a narrow initial schema could make later sector support impossible without semantic migration.
open_decisions.next_step: P16/P17: specify safe and unsafe groupings, a perimeter transition and lost-exposure counterexamples; derive state/interface requirements before storage selection.

open_decisions.question: What scenario and probability claims belong in the initial profile?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Specify transparent conditional scenarios and optional justified joint measures; preserve unweighted alternatives, information cutoffs, dependence and unresolved mass.
open_decisions.alternative: Require probabilistic company forecasts by default or normalise successful branches alone.
open_decisions.consequence: Conditional stress is useful without calibrated probabilities; unsupported weighting would misstate evidence and can introduce look-ahead.
open_decisions.next_step: P16/P17: specify operating assumptions, conditioning and failure examples; leave P13-style calibration, matched forecast baselines and uncertainty evidence as separate empirical obligations.

open_decisions.question: Which reusable components may supply which financial operations?
open_decisions.proposed_answer: Separate evidence import, contract scheduling, valuation, accounting rule application and ledger exchange; propose pinned adapters with explicit retained fields and failures.
open_decisions.alternative: Let an upstream schedule/valuation/ledger engine decide accounting treatment, or defer interface analysis until implementation.
open_decisions.consequence: Tool presence or a plausible exchange format cannot establish semantic compatibility; P11 completed zero external integrations.
open_decisions.next_step: P17: inspect pinned official interfaces/licences and define positive/adversarial exchanges, transformation losses and unavailable-backend behavior; finish feasible internal preparation before professional questions.

candidate_initial_profile: Candidate A, corporate/shared-IR: a bounded operating company linking a reviewed annual/interim disclosure package and declared opening state to jointly admissible histories, economic events, dated treatments, journals and a full statement set. Include explicit source/context/review, chronology, uncertainty and incomplete-result semantics; specify later sector/group/standards obligations. Text authoring is optional at this stage. Northstar provides synthetic expected arithmetic; Apple provides partial real-source preparation. Neither establishes full real-company semantics. This is one comparison candidate; no architecture, Core 0, Python, solver or storage choice is approved.
profile_alternative: Candidate B, typed-library-first, holds A's corporate scope, source package, events, histories, cutoffs and expected results fixed while using typed constructors and inspectable serialised records and deferring a mandatory textual frontend; domain validation and later DSL design remain required. Candidate C, instrument-first, prioritises an issuer/holder lifecycle and connected-book contributions while explicitly retaining unmodelled company disclosures and assigning corporate continuation; incomplete P08 cannot establish cross-standard treatments or whole-company coverage. Candidate D, broad sector-first, includes corporate/bank/insurance and dated standards/group interactions initially, making the presently missing authority and multi-period methods initial dependencies. The audit compares all four on identical evidence, histories, events/treatments, statements, uncertainty, chronology/failures, review/recovery, extension, authority/reuse and acceptance obligations. B is an authoring variant combinable with any domain, not a mutually exclusive domain. No effort, performance or usability ranking is supported.
selection_question: Which initial accounting scope and which authoring interface should P16 propose, with independently specified source-to-result examples and explicit later obligations for every MC01–MC35/G1–G18 requirement? Use the saved Initial-profile comparison, disclose changed domain coverage for A/C/D, and hold domain/inputs/results fixed for A/B. Reject any candidate that loses evidence, joint alternatives, chronology, treatment boundaries or unresolved outcomes. Require method/authority and extension dependencies before selection; prototype availability and test counts do not decide it.
